title: Houston Has a Waterfront
why: Cold Houston locals (Schwartz unaware): bust the 'nothing to do in Houston' myth and show Clear Lake exists.
hook_options: Nothing to do in Houston? Try the water.
Most Houstonians don't know this exists.
Houston has a waterfront. Get on it.
caption: Downtown bar, rooftop, dinner again. Or: your whole crew on Clear Lake with your own cooler, your own playlist, and a captain at the wheel. Up to 26 guests, roof and bathroom on board, ages 8 and up. Houston has a waterfront. Get on it. #houston #clearlake #kemah #houstonthingstodo #partybarge
